description: This file contains Dart data models for content-related entities such as ContentItem, ContentRail, and HomeFeedPayload with JSON serialization/deserialization methods.

classes.name: ContentItem
classes.description: Represents a media content item with fields like id, title, posterUrl, description, durationSeconds, and genres.

classes.name: ContentRail
classes.description: Represents a collection of ContentItems grouped under a rail, identified by id and title.

classes.name: HomeFeedPayload
classes.description: Wraps a list of ContentRails for the home feed display.

methods.name: ContentItem.fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor to create a ContentItem instance from a JSON map.

methods.name: ContentItem.toJson
methods.description: Converts a ContentItem instance to a JSON map.

methods.name: ContentRail.fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor to create a ContentRail instance from a JSON map.

methods.name: ContentRail.toJson
methods.description: Converts a ContentRail instance to a JSON map.

methods.name: HomeFeedPayload.fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor to create a HomeFeedPayload from a JSON map.

methods.name: HomeFeedPayload.toJson
methods.description: Converts a HomeFeedPayload instance to a JSON map.
